method.eligibility: Minimum recorded bouts is applied once before opponent and component filtering.
method.groups: Each weapon and gender is fitted independently. Mixed-gender events are excluded.
method.outcomes: Only Fenced rows with a winner equal to one of two distinct opponents are used.
method.component: Largest weakly connected component after eligibility filtering.
method.solver: Sparse direct solution of the SpringRank Laplacian objective, then mean-centered.
method.matching: Unique normalized names within each category; not license-verified identity resolution.
method.rankings: Archived 2025/26 FIE ranking CSVs; retrieval date not recorded in original files.
method.interpretation: Agreement with archived rankings is concurrent validation, not held-out prediction.

discrepancy_prediction.identity_policy: Conservatively exclude normalized names recorded under multiple countries from grouped prediction.
discrepancy_prediction.validation: Country-grouped outer folds and country-grouped inner tuning; no future-rank forecasting claim.

brier_improvement.interpretation: Positive means lower held-out Brier error with biographies.

bout_prediction.traits_caveat: Birth dates are time-invariant; handedness comes from current profile records and is assumed stable. Clubs/coaches are excluded.

research.caveat: Conditional on recorded events and observed athletes. Beta is not intrinsic luck; ranking disagreement does not establish true ability.

zonal_points.rule: Best five World Cup/Grand Prix/Satellite point results plus world/Olympic and zonal points. Remove the zonal slot; no sixth ordinary replacement.
